description: Single source of truth for the pinned Apache Tika backend. Update tika.version, tika.jar_url and tika.jar_sha512 together; the Python loader and the install scripts both read this file.

java.install_version_notes: jabba alias form: 'temurin@~11' installs the newest Java 11 build; 'temurin@=11.0.29' pins an exact patch build. Pass --java-version to the install scripts to override.
